discovery_warrant.reason: The candidate ladder can be falsified against the already-corrected frozen W source and neutral graph. No new experimental observation is needed merely to determine whether these candidates add unsupported semantics.

hypotheses.candidate_statement: Treat action-parent + selected varied role + declared result incidence as the complete reusable semantics needed for the four target occurrences.
hypotheses.declared_scope: Only the four corrected W target occurrences.
hypotheses.motivating_evidence: Corrected W G1 explicitly preserves action parents, field/role selection, and declared results.
predicted_consequences: All four targets can be represented as action/role/result incidence.
The five non-variation consequence controls remain outside the target pattern.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exact reconstruction still requires the source word 'varying/variation' to carry semantic behavior not represented by action/role/result incidence alone.
hypotheses.adaptive_evidence: Corrected G1 0.21 and G4 0.2 were produced after the predecessor 211000 mismatch and are adaptive evidence.
hypotheses.coverage_limits: No claim beyond the four target occurrences.
hypotheses.reason: The incidence skeleton is already representable without a new semantic primitive, but deleting the unresolved meaning of variation changes the source claim. Therefore the skeleton is useful structure but insufficient closure.

hypotheses.candidate_statement: Introduce a generic selected-role VARIES_TO(action, role, result) relation whose extension is exactly the source-declared target tuples.
hypotheses.declared_scope: Generic finite relation intended to cover the four target W occurrences.
hypotheses.motivating_evidence: The source explicitly says varying selected roles gives stated results.
predicted_consequences: All four targets are extensionally represented.
Non-target consequence statements are excluded by requiring an action parent and selected varied role.
hypotheses.falsifier: If VARIES_TO has no behavior below the same undefined source operation it is meant to reduce, it is an opaque rename and violates No-Evasion Primitive Closure.
hypotheses.adaptive_evidence: Refines the previously rejected weak variation-result relation using corrected role incidence.
hypotheses.coverage_limits: No claim beyond the target relation.
hypotheses.reason: The candidate reifies the source wording but supplies no internal transformation law, reconstruction behavior, or independently testable semantics beyond the tuples it was invented to encode.

hypotheses.candidate_statement: Define selected-role variation as controlled replacement/perturbation of one represented action role while other represented roles are held fixed, with before/after action evaluation determining a result relation.
hypotheses.declared_scope: Source-neutral transformation candidate tested for instantiation at the four corrected W targets.
hypotheses.motivating_evidence: The source names selected fields/roles and declares different results when each is varied.
predicted_consequences: The varied role is an action dependency.
The source instantiates a perturbation/replacement carrier.
Held-fixed role semantics and before/after evaluation are representable.
Role swapping and variation of a non-dependent role are rejected.
negative_adversarial_controls: vary a role absent from represented action dependencies
swap the varied role while retaining the original result
accept arbitrary consequence language without an action parent
hypotheses.falsifier: If perturbation/replacement carriers, held-fixed roles, or before/after evaluation are not source-instantiable, the candidate adds unstated behavior.
hypotheses.adaptive_evidence: This is the genuinely behavioral successor to the opaque candidate.
hypotheses.coverage_limits: No generic qualification is attempted if W cannot instantiate the interface.
hypotheses.reason: Corrected W source still does not state perturbation/replacement carriers, held-fixed roles, or before/after action evaluations.

hypotheses.candidate_statement: Treat variation as a generic equation-of-motion extraction operation from an action with respect to a selected field/role.
hypotheses.declared_scope: Attempted bridge over W01 and W02 variation consequences.
hypotheses.motivating_evidence: Corrected W01 explicitly says equations of motion are obtained by varying its fundamental fields.
prohibited_evidence: assuming W02's results are equations of motion unless its frozen source states that role
predicted_consequences: W01 target results are source-labeled as equations of motion.
W02 must independently supply the same equation-of-motion role if the candidate is to cover both bodies.
The extraction operation must have behavior below the word 'variation'.
negative_adversarial_controls: W02 lacks an explicit equation-of-motion label in the corrected frozen body
a named result without extraction behavior must not define an operator
hypotheses.falsifier: Failure of W02 to source-establish the EOM role or failure to define extraction behavior below variation falsifies the reusable cross-body candidate.
hypotheses.adaptive_evidence: Generated from the new W01 equations-of-motion detail exposed by the targeted source correction.
hypotheses.coverage_limits: A W01-only statement would not be a reusable cross-body generic variation primitive and would still leave D1 unresolved.
hypotheses.reason: W01 supplies an EOM label but not the internal variation operation; W02 does not independently supply the same EOM-role statement in the corrected body. Promoting a common operator would import semantics.

hypotheses.declared_scope: The four corrected W target occurrences only.
hypotheses.motivating_evidence: Historical W hypothesis and campaign-provisional G6 qualification exist.
prohibited_evidence: Treating the prior provisional qualification as proof of W source instantiation

If neither exists, preserve this W current-authority boundary.
